cases.prompt: DB 스택 선택이 비가역적이라 AI들끼리 토론 붙여서 결정하자. 다관점으로 합의 보자.

assertions.text: Checks readiness of all four vendor seats (Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini via agy) with debate.py seats before arguing, and shows the attendance in one line.
Each present vendor argues a distinct lens (proponent, skeptic, alternative, user-interest) from real evidence, not identical copies or same-vendor personas.
Uses a separate blind judge call on anonymized positions, preferably a vendor other than the orchestrator, and says why the losers lost.
Records a hub-format D-code entry in DECISIONS.md with the attendance line, positions, judge rationale, verdict and a preserved minority view.

cases.prompt: This naming decision is contested and irreversible — debate this and get multiple positions before we merge.

assertions.text: Chooses full mode for an irreversible decision: positions, cross-examination with UNCHANGED/REVISED, blind judge, then ACCEPT/OBJECT ratification by every present seat.
Resolves by consensus or a Claude tiebreak with written rationale, escalating safety-rail decisions to Simon.
Links the D-code from the gated artifact (PR/merge/spec) so the merge gate can verify the debate record exists.

cases.prompt: Codex 주간 한도가 100%고 Grok도 소진됐어. 그래도 4개 벤더로 토론해서 이 머지 결정해줘. 추가 과금은 절대 안 돼.

assertions.text: Does not call the Codex or Grok seats while their quota evidence shows exhaustion or purchased-credit billing risk; records them as absent with the evidence and reset time.
Never fills the absent seats with personas from another vendor and never reports the debate as 4/4.
Marks the verdict PROVISIONAL with the present vendor count, limits action to reversible steps, and lists the catch-up duty for the absent vendors via debate.py catchup.

cases.prompt: codex가 이 스킬 업데이트를 몇 시간째 붙잡고 있어. 너무 오래 걸려. 중간에 겐세이 좀 넣어줘.

assertions.text: Runs interject_scan.py scan to find the long-running session and names the triggers found (long turn, HOLD loop, user frustration, quota).
Builds a snapshot and runs an interject-mode debate across the available vendor seats whose answers start with CALL: CONTINUE/RESCOPE/SHIP_NOW/STOP/ASK_USER.
Produces a short card.md with one next action and a time box, shows it to the user, and only types into the agent's Orca terminal with an explicit --orca-terminal and --send.

cases.prompt: You have been stuck on the same release gate for an hour. Interject before you spend more time.

assertions.text: Applies interject mode to the orchestrator itself instead of continuing the loop, summarizing the goal, elapsed time and blockers as evidence.
Acts on the judge CALL (for example RESCOPE or SHIP_NOW) with the single next action, or asks the user when the call is ASK_USER or a safety rail applies.

cases.prompt: You are running inside Codex CLI. Use ai-debate to decide whether we migrate the job queue to SQLite; get all four vendors in.

assertions.text: Runs debate.py seats and new with --orchestrator openai (the Codex host value), never relying on a default or naming anthropic.
Answers the Codex seat in-session and registers it with submit --vendor openai instead of spawning codex through call, and calls the Claude, Grok and Gemini seats through call.
Leaves an UNKNOWN or absent Claude seat recorded as absent instead of writing a Claude answer itself, and names the catch-up path where a live Claude Code session submits with --host-session.

cases.prompt: (agy에서) grok이 한 시간째 같은 작업을 붙잡고 있어. 겐세이 좀 넣어줘.

assertions.text: Runs interject_scan.py scan, finds the Grok session (agent grok) with its open turn and triggers, and snapshots its updates.jsonl as evidence.
Opens the interject debate with --orchestrator google and --subject-vendor xai, answers the Gemini seat in-session with submit, and lets judge-pick skip both the host and the stuck vendor.
Delivers a short card.md with one next action and a time box, shown to the user, without force-stopping the Grok agent.
